verdict.rationale: Khoj is an AI assistant with agents, so plugging in MCP servers as a client is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions MCP or connecting external tool servers. Its agents' 'tools' (khoj-gh-1) and built-in features like code execution and online search are adjacent first-party capabilities, not MCP client support.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
